verdict.rationale: Numeral ships an official MCP server exposing nexus status, filings, registrations, transactions, and exemption certificates as callable tools with existing scoped secret API keys, plus a full REST API for calculations, transactions, registrations, and certificate requests. This directly matches the story of an agent reading tax posture and acting on it via API/MCP. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server in production (only vendor docs and a doc probe confirm it), and explicit detail on credential scoping granularity beyond 'existing secret API key'.
